items.title: Nvidia, AMD, and Micron stocks lead chip sector higher following worst sell-off since 2020

items.title: Stocks lost $2 trillion. The market is wrong about AI
items.summary: The stock market lost $2 trillion in 40 minutes, and AI stocks took the worst of it, with Intel down more than half since October and AMD off 17% in a day. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why it happened and why he thinks the market is wrong, from GPU rental prices up 106% to the CPU boom and Anthropic's IPO valuation.

items.title: Nvidia stock oversold setup: Key levels after a 9% drop
items.summary: Investing.com -- NVIDIA (NVDA) is rebounding after Thursday’s drop of 9.3%, its worst day since January 2025. All figures are as of Nov 6, 2026, 9:33 AM EST, early in the session. The stock is at $193.09 (+6.33%). Thursday’s close was $181.60, after an intraday low of $181.46.
